stories.title: Clubhouse Leader
stories.detail: 21 pts for Wendy Mangelsdorf, top of the table and the sausage sizzle already fired up for the presentation.

stories.title: The Home Team
stories.detail: Wendy and Neil are flying the Mangelsdorf flag today, and Sunday lunch just got competitive.

stories.title: Welcome to WWCC
stories.detail: Great to see Robert Oliver make the trip over from Cowra GC for a hit with us.

stories.title: Short-Hole Sniper
stories.detail: 3 threes on the par 3s - dialled in with the irons

stories.title: Short-Hole Assassin
stories.detail: 3-pointers on 2 of the par 3s - the short holes never stood a chance

stories.title: Settling In
stories.detail: 3 twos in a row on holes 5, 6 & 7 - starting to look comfortable

stories.title: Building Something
stories.detail: 3 twos on holes 4, 5 & 6 - the round is taking shape

stories.title: 1-Pointer Mode Activated
stories.detail: 4 in a row on holes 2-5 - consistent, at least

stories.title: Speed Bump
stories.detail: 3-pointer on hole 1, wipe on hole 2 - the course corrects

stories.title: Hero to Zero
stories.detail: 3-pointer then a wipe on holes 1 & 2 - feast then famine

stories.title: Footy Form Guide
stories.detail: Mike Bradley dropped 11 pts off a 1.2 average, the handballs simply would not stick today.
